### The Blessings Found in the Fire - Encouragement for Today - July 25, 2019
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-25-2019.html
Passage: Malachi 3:3
Points:
- Hardships and persistent struggles serve as opportunities for God to shape our character rather than our comfort.
- Just as John the Baptist prepared the way for Christ, believers today are called as messengers who need purified hearts.
- God works like a refiner's fire and strong soap to burn away impurities and remove the defilement of sin.
- The goal of sanctification is to restore our lives so they clearly mirror the character of our Creator.
- Believers can trust God through painful seasons, knowing that no trial is purposeless in His refining hands.

### The Refiner's Fire - From His Heart - August 22
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-august-20-11636606.html
Passage: Malachi 3:3
Points:
- God leads His children into fiery trials to purge selfish attitudes and make them more like Jesus.
- The Lord sits attentively over the refining fire and never neglects or abandons His people in their affliction.
- God governs the timing of our trials with perfect precision, never pulling us out early or leaving us too long.
- The refining process reaches completion when all dross is removed and the Lord sees His own reflection in us.
